raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure contains two vertically stacked line charts showing training rewards versus steps for two methods on different training sets. In both panels, the x-axis is labeled “Steps” on a linear scale from 0 to 500 with major ticks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis in both panels is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top panel it spans roughly 0.0 to 0.4 (with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4), and in the bottom panel it spans roughly 0.0 to 0.2 (with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2). The top panel is titled “Easy Training Set” and includes two solid lines with light shaded bands around them: a blue line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” that rises from near 0 at step 0 to about 0.25 by ~100 steps and then fluctuates around ~0.30–0.36 through step 500, ending near ~0.35; and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” that rises from near 0 at step 0 to about ~0.22–0.25 by ~100 steps and continues upward with fluctuations, reaching around ~0.40 by step 500. The bottom panel is titled “Hard Training Set” and also shows two solid lines with light shaded bands: a blue line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” that starts near ~0.02–0.03 at step 0, drops toward ~0 by roughly 80–120 steps, and remains near 0 for the rest of the steps; and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” that starts near 0, increases to about ~0.10 by ~50–100 steps, then continues a gradual upward trend with oscillations, reaching roughly ~0.20 by step 500.
